ENGLISH: Fires an event that says which TGC version is loaded. Can be used once per game.
TGCX loaded on top of TGC v2.5.2
The TGCX submod loaded. The United Kingdom has the great_gamer flag, which only TGC v2.5.2 (or later) sets.
TGCX loaded on top of TGC v2.3.4
The TGCX submod loaded. The United Kingdom does not have the great_gamer flag: this TGC is older than v2.5.2.
